title: Run the next ablation experiment for parameter-golf

operationalConstraints: Use TASK_STORE_DIR as the authoritative source when selecting the next ablation candidate.
Append one bounded ablation experiment record to authoritative evidence and refresh generated campaign views.
Keep this spike scoped to evidentiary execution outcomes without any benchmark-readiness promotion side effects.

boundaries: Task store selection is the boundary that determines which ablation candidate can execute next.
This slice is bounded to a single ablation execution append plus view regeneration through existing evidence pathways.
Readiness and benchmark-promotion flows remain out of scope for FAST-28 to avoid hidden behavior expansion.
interfaces: Input: task-store payload with lane=ablation, candidateId, runConfig, traceId, and budgetCaps.
Input/Output: authoritative evidence interface that appends one ablation record and updates summary projections.
Output: execution outcome payload with taskId, candidateId, lane, reasonCode, status, and completedAt for operators.
risks: Missing lane isolation could let non-ablation tasks consume ablation budget and distort campaign sequencing.
Weak evidence update guarantees could leave operator-facing status/state views stale after a run.
Unbounded reruns could burn budget without improving the next-candidate ablation signal.
implementationReadyDecisions: Candidate seed is fixed to ablation-next-candidate for this FAST-28 spike.
Budget cap is fixed by maxAblationExperiments=1 for this bounded ablation pass.
Outputs are evidentiary-only and explicitly do not claim benchmark readiness.
